purpose: Pre-registration for one official test_realgen evaluation; this file contains no official test metrics.

run_policy.reruns: prohibited; workflow refuses if any earlier official dispatch exists
run_policy.result_bridge: GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY and check-runs output.text; raw result artifact retained 90 days
run_policy.run_id: must be actual GITHUB_RUN_ID; no synthetic run IDs

reports/science/real/REALGEN_FROZEN.json.source: existing REALGEN-R1 freeze/phase-B artifacts; dev-only or metadata

test_realgen_answers.source: copied from existing REALGEN_FROZEN.json metadata; file not opened during preparation

test_realgen_labels_and_spans.source: copied from existing REALGEN_FROZEN.json metadata; file not opened during preparation

test_answer_context_source.source: copied from existing REALGEN_FROZEN.json metadata; file not opened during preparation

r2_only.definition: LogisticRegression(class_weight=balanced,max_iter=1000) with StandardScaler on the fixed 16 R2 features only; excludes E1 and old5.

models.calibration: No post-hoc fit or calibration on test; raw frozen predict_proba/softmax scores are reported. No test-based fitting, threshold tuning, or model updates.

model_bundle.required_before_ready: A complete full-dev frozen bundle for all three named models, including inference backend and pinned upstream model revisions, with SHA256 and real Actions provenance.
model_bundle.blocking_finding: Phase B persisted five-fold OOF scores and summary only; it did not persist a full-dev composite estimator, R2-only estimator, or fine-tuned rubert-tiny2 deployment weights. These cannot be represented as frozen model artifacts. Official run is refused until a separate dev-only freeze step produces and registers them.

policies.span_aggregation: Word-token probabilities are means of overlapping subtokens. Thresholded adjacent token intervals with a gap of at most one character are merged into character spans. One-to-one greedy IoU matching; hit iff IoU >= 0.5.
policies.brier: Mean squared probability error at token and answer levels.
policies.ece: 10 equal-width probability bins, [0,1], last bin closed at 1.
policies.auc: Mann-Whitney ROC AUC with average ranks for ties.

suite_green_confirmation.test_matrix: Ubuntu Python 3.11 and Windows Python 3.12 passed; full suite includes test_realgen_freeze.py and test_frozen_prediction_files_byte_identical.

risk_disclosure: REALGEN labels are generated by deterministic number/citation rules; lexical feature/label circularity can inflate scores.
A single synthetic generator and 100 held-out responses do not establish transfer to free-form/external generation.
R2-only baseline excludes E1 and old5 by construction.
The existing Phase B OOF scores do not constitute deployable frozen estimators; model bundle remains a hard block.
The permanent real_test 1200 split is not read or used in any role.
